description: Apache Superset connector (read-only). Surfaces Superset dashboards — title, slug, published flag, status, owner count, last editor, changed timestamp — into the local index as `superset:dashboard` items. Superset has no static API key: the connector authenticates with username/password against `POST /api/v1/security/login` to obtain a short-lived JWT, then calls the dashboards API with `Authorization: Bearer <access_token>`. Superset has no universal SaaS host: the server host is supplied via the `superset.url` vault key and added to the sandbox network list at spawn time by `phase3AddSupersetMcp`, so the static manifest network list is intentionally empty. v1 indexes dashboards only — charts, datasets, saved queries, and write tools are a deferred follow-up. No write tools.
author: Nimbus
